one_liner: Leading graph database platform enabling developers to build applications powered by connected data with HTTP, Query, and Aura cloud APIs.
access_notes: AuraDB offers a free tier and self-serve plans with trial options, while advanced features require paid or enterprise plans.
verdict_reason: Neo4j provides self-serve cloud tiers (AuraDB Free), official MCP servers, drivers, and documented REST/Query APIs.

evidence.snippet: API keys are prefixed `nams_` (legacy `gylrd_` keys are still accepted). Send the key as a Bearer token on every request
Neo4j publishes its prices; its AuraDB Free plan is $0 as of 2026-10-28.
